reviews.author: Marian Chyzh
reviews.text:
I had a keratin treatment with this lovely stylist, and I am absolutely thrilled with the results! My hair is now incredibly smooth, shiny, and much easier to manage. She was professional, attentive, and took the time to explain the whole process and answer all my questions.

The salon atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable, and I felt well taken care of throughout the appointment. The results exceeded my expectations, and I highly recommend her services to anyone looking for a high-quality keratin treatment. Thank you for making my hair look and feel amazing!
